newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-GPG accepts Foster's bid for Ballarat.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-GPG accepts Foster's bid for Ballarat.

text.p: New Zealand-based corporate raider Guinness Peat Group Plc (GPG) said on Wednesday it had accepted the revised A$2.56 per share offer from Foster's Brewing Group for its stake in Ballarat Brewing Co Ltd.
GPG said in a substantial shareholder notice issued on January 7 that it had 4.85 million shares or 17.90 percent of Ballarat's issued capital.
GPG made a takeover bid for Ballarat at A$2.45 per share in September and increased it to A$2.50 in early January.
But this bid was trumped earlier this week by Foster's which raised its A$2.50 bid made in November to A$2.56.

"The takeover offer from GPG for Ballarat Brewing will be allowed to expire on 6 February 1997 and GPG advises other Ballarat Brewing shareholders to accept the higher offer...", GPG director Ron Brierley said in a statement.
Foster's said in a substantial shareholder notice earlier on Wednesday that it had 42.49 percent of Ballarat, a pub operator.
Ballarat has said shareholders should reject the A$2.50 bids by Foster's and GPG because they were below the fair value range assessed by Grant Samuel & Associates of A$2.56 to A$2.93 a share.
Ballarat shares were down two cents at A$2.62 at 10.50 a.m. (2350 GMT).
